name: Thorn
overview: Scripture presents thorns as a symbol of the cursed ground resulting from sin, as seen in Genesis 3:18 where thorns and thistles are part of the earth's curse. They also represent affliction and adversity, described in Numbers 33:55 as pricks and thorns that vex God's people when disobedient. Thorns have practical uses, including as tools like an awl (Job 41:2) and for fuel (Psalms 118:12), yet they also figuratively depict the snares and evils that arise to hinder the faithful, as Proverbs 22:5 warns of thorns in the way of the froward. The crown of thorns mockingly placed on Jesus' head further underscores their association with suffering and the cost of redemption.
